title: CUB K1 image-only active keypoint annotation selection screen
research_question: At one keypoint-annotated image per class, can an image-only selector improve mean recognition benefit or reduce class-level negative transfer relative to random selection?

selector.feature_transform: deterministic 384x384 bicubic resize and ImageNet normalization

strategies.MEDOID: maximum cosine similarity to the leave-one-out class centroid
strategies.BALANCED_ANNOTATION_VALUE: harmonic mean of within-class representativeness and uncertainty percentile ranks, with no tunable weight

training.model: frozen PAT-D-260728-001 ResNet-50 layer4-adapted PrPool stack

screening_gate.ranking: benefit passers first by BA descending, negative-transfer rate ascending, worst-class harm descending; if only safety passers, negative-transfer rate ascending then BA descending
screening_gate.on_no_pass: stop before PAT-D-260728-006 and all final evaluation
